headword: {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}
reading: さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ

definitions.gloss: the athlete judged to have performed best in a game, tournament, or season; the Most Valuable Player (MVP)
definitions.explanation: An official award in professional and amateur sports honoring the player whose performance was judged to have contributed the most to a team's success over a given game, series, tournament, or season. Used across virtually every competitive sport in Japan — professional baseball, soccer, basketball, volleyball, and high-school tournaments alike. Often abbreviated MVP (read エムブイピー) in Japanese sports media.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as this year's Most Valuable Player.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧だった。
examples.english: He was the MVP of the final.

examples.japanese: {大谷|おおたに}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|こん}→今〜：03952_kon⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ohtani won this season's Most Valuable Player award.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二年|にねん}→二年：28862_ninen⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{快挙|かいきょ}→快挙：12579_kaikyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げた→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧。
examples.english: She achieved the remarkable feat of being voted the league's Most Valuable Player for two years in a row.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{最|さい}→最〜：03954_sai⟧- (the most, supreme) + ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧ (excellent, outstanding) + ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (athlete, player). Literally "the most outstanding player." The standard Japanese rendering of "MVP."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: the MVP award / Most Valuable Player Award
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be selected as MVP
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win the MVP title
- {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to win the MVP award
- ⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧MVP / ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}: season MVP, annual MVP

USAGE:
Japanese sports media often use the English abbreviation MVP (read エムブイピー) interchangeably with {最優秀選手|さいゆうしゅうせんしゅ}. On NHK and in official league announcements, the full Japanese form is usually preferred; in casual sports journalism and fan conversation, "MVP" is equally common.

RELATED AWARD TERMS:
- {最優秀新人選手|さいゆうしゅうしんじんせんしゅ} / ⟦{新人王|しんじんおう}→新人王：18556_shinjinou⟧: Rookie of the Year
- {優秀選手|ゆうしゅうせんしゅ}: outstanding player (a step below MVP; several may be chosen)
- ⟦{首位打者|しゅいだしゃ}→首位打者：26604_shuidasha⟧: batting champion (baseball)
- {最多勝|さいたしょう}: most wins (baseball pitcher)
- ⟦{得点王|とくてんおう}→得点王：18555_tokutenou⟧: top scorer (soccer)
- {敢闘賞|かんとうしょう}: fighting-spirit award
- {殊勲賞|しゅくんしょう}: distinguished-service award

REGISTER:
Formal and written. Appears on trophies, in press releases, and in official team communications. Casual fans will also say MVP directly.
